full_judgment: 2. Material facts are that on 05-02-2007 petitioner as pre-emptor instituted pre-emption Misc. case no.02 of 2007 in the Court of Assistant Judge, for pre-emption of the case land under section 96 of the State Acquisition of Tenancy Act 1950 (briefly as Act) by depositing consideration money for Tk.62,000/- together with compensation at the rate of 10 per centum of such amount.
